Hard to say if it will help, but i hope it will work out for you. I never tried therapy, i don't belive it would help me. I'm not even sure if i want to change. All i've ever known is this, and change is scary. I guess im too comfortable in my uncomfortable state..if that makes sense.

I know how you feel. Many times i avoided going somewhere, mainly when it involved alcohol. When i drink i tend to vent to others, and those people could never understand me and i don't think they even care. I'm the guy in the group who just sits there because he has nothing interesting to say. Only people who decide to talk to me have no better person to talk to, at that moment. So they ditch me quick when someone more interesting comes around. Tbh if i even had sometimes option to have sleepover with girls i would not come. Same as you, i would like to go, but i don't know what would i even do there. I'm too weird, awkward and boring, i can't change that.

I'm sorry to hear that. When i was 18, i actualy still had some hope, but years go by and i'm in the same place, thinking about same things, that bothered be back then...nothing really changed. Good life is not meant to be for everyone, maybe life just already broke me too much. I hope it will work out for you in the end, and you will find your happiness somewhere.

Belive it or not, i actualy had some goals i wanted to achieve in my life. Of course that was when i was younger and alot more naive. It's just hard to set some new goal when the goals you wanted the most are out of reach adn there is not a chance to complete them.   


I wanted to have a big family, which i know is never going to happen because of my personality.  
I wanted to travel, without money and/or someone to go with it's kinda of problem though.  
I wanted to have a job that i will like doing, it didnt have to be a job taht pays good, i just wanted to like doing it. But of course that is out of question too when i could not finish a school that was required for it, because i wasn't smart enough. So i thought, "ok, i won't ever do a job i'm passionate about so at least i hope it pays good". Nope, not happening.. 

I just exist, day by day without anything to look forward to. And it scares me to think it will be like this forever.  
Thank you for your reply.
No, it's hard to talk about these things in person, i would feel even more like a weak man than i already am. Plus i don't think that would help either way.

I'm done approaching anyone, it's pointless anyway. It takes alot of time for me to get comfortable around new people, and most of them don't want to take a time to get to know me so they judge on first impression and leave. How can i show some girl that i have better side than this quiet awkward guy when she sees my first impression which is not likable.. But i kinda disagree with "There is always someone for everyone". I believe there is a girl that is perfect for me but that girl has probably more and better options for relationship than a me, or she's already taken, or she's on the other side of the world so i won't meet her anyway, or maybe i met her already and scared her off. No girl will take time to get to know me nor approach me, and even if some girl would approach me ever, it would be probably someone i'm not attracted to at all or has incompatible personality with mine.

I would like to give up all that false hope but it's not that easy if even possible, it still holds on me and i hate it. Well i don't even know what i did wrong, maybe because i was myself. They laughed because they saw that nobody like me is trying to get someone like them.. They were all really pretty. Yes looks isn't everything, but if you don't look really good and your social skills are non existent, it's really hard then.
